svg.text: One control plane and two ARM workers; the NLB exposes the application entry point.
AWS VPC / eu-north-1 · one Availability Zone
Pods run on the two workers · Calico VXLAN
Egress: NAT → registry, AniList, SSM, packages
NetworkPolicies: ingress-nginx → frontend → backend → DB. Application TLS, PostgreSQL HA and backups are not configured.
